scheme_name: Incentive for Purchase of Electric Scooter for the Daughter of a Registered Construction Worker (HBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered construction worker with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and have a minimum of one year regular, active membership
Daughter must hold a valid two‑wheeler driving licence
Daughter must have scored at least 60% in class 12th examinations
Only one electric scooter purchase is allowed per family
Worker must add a minimum of 90 days work experience of the preceding year and pay the registration fee before benefits can be availed
Purchase bill of the electric scooter must be uploaded within one month of receiving the incentive, otherwise future benefits are denied
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹50,000 or the actual ex‑showroom price of an electric scooter, whichever is lower, to the eligible daughter via e‑RUPI.
documents_required: Purchase bill of the electric scooter
